preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100,000.
The number of cities n must be between 3 and 1,000,000.
The subset size q must be between 3 and the number of cities n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of roads that need to be demolished for each test case.
